hero.title: 63 BUILDING
hero.subtitle: Meet Seoul from the golden heart of 63 floors

intro.title: The New Beginning of 63
intro.desc: 63 Building, a symbol of Seoul since its completion in 1985, has been completely reborn. We welcome you as a premium complex cultural space combining observatory, art gallery, dining, and retail.

hero.title: 63 Building Story
hero.subtitle: 40 Years of History, A New Beginning

1985.title: Opening
1985.desc: Completed as Korea's first skyscraper. The golden 63-story, 249m building transformed Seoul's skyline.

1990.title: Growth
1990.desc: Developed into a complex cultural space with an observatory, aquarium, and shopping mall, becoming Seoul's iconic destination.

2020.title: Renewal
2020.desc: Major renovation updated F&B, retail, and cultural facilities. A world-class art space was born through collaboration with the Pompidou Center.

2024.title: Rebirth
2024.desc: 63 Building is reborn in a new form. Honoring 40 years of history while beginning a new journey toward the future.

brand.title: Brand Philosophy
brand.desc: 63 Building is more than just a building. It is a space that holds the dreams and aspirations of Seoul citizens, the pride of Korea reaching out to the world, and a complex cultural space that offers special moments to everyone.

concept.title: The New Ground Floor
concept.desc: 63 Building's ground floor has been reborn with the concept of a 'Golden Forest.' The interior design, inspired by the building's golden exterior, guides visitors into a special world away from the everyday.

light.title: Light & Gold
light.desc: The golden glow, the symbol of 63 Building, is woven throughout the interior space.

nature.title: Nature & City
nature.desc: The elements of water, wind, and light are incorporated into the space design, reflecting the geographical characteristics of its Han River location.

heritage.title: Heritage & Present
heritage.desc: The identity of a 40-year-old building is respected and reinterpreted with a modern sensibility.

info.title: Seoul from the Sky
info.desc: Seoul's 360° panorama unfolds at the 60th floor, 249m high. On a clear day, you can take in all of Seoul from Bukhansan to Gwanaksan, along the Han River.

view360.title: 360° Panorama
view360.desc: View all of Seoul at once

info.title: Paris Comes to Seoul
info.desc: A new cultural space born through collaboration with the Centre Pompidou in Paris. Experience world-class contemporary art in Seoul.

info.title: 63 Seafood Buffet
info.desc: A premium buffet where you can enjoy fresh seasonal seafood and a variety of domestic and international dishes. The live cooking stations staffed by chefs provide the ultimate dining experience.

info.title: A Gastronomic Journey in the Sky
info.desc: Premium restaurants spanning floors 57 to 59. The ultimate dining experience with the Han River as a backdrop. Making your special day even more special.
